integrity: Proof uses exact conditioning on individual record sites; finite exact enumeration and weighted tests in verify.py support the proof but do not establish infinite statements.
scientific_limitations: The local all-pairs covariance kernel is proved exactly for uniform permutations and iid continuous ranks. The full texts of Katzenbeisser (1988, 1990) could not be inspected; priority comparison is qualified. The previously studied aggregate record-inversion joint moment is not asserted original.
title: A flat left-endpoint covariance kernel for permutation records and inversions
